summaries.Romania: Romania's government advances administrative reform and budget planning while managing political tensions around extremist movements and infrastructure projects. Key fiscal and institutional restructuring efforts proceed amid PSD-led governance.

items.title: Criza Nvidia: Jensen Huang a demisionat din fruntea gigantului AI, după scandalul de spionaj care a dus și la pierderi pe bursă
items.snippet: Jensen Huang și-a dat demisia din funcțiile de conducere deținute la Nvidia, a anunțat joi consiliul de administrație al companiei, citat de BBC. items.line: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation over affairs with alleged Chinese spy and subordinate signals potential national security breach in AI infrastructure at critical moment in US-China tech competition.

items.title: STAT+: Blackstone backs Pfizer’s bet on monthly obesity treatment
items.snippet: Pfizer spent up to $10 billion to buy Metsera last year. Now, it’s bringing in private equity behemoth Blackstone to help pay for the deal.

items.title: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress
items.snippet: Huang, who was ousted as CEO following reports of an alleged affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, agreed to testify Wednesday after several senior lawmakers threatened to subpoena him.
items.line: Jensen Huang agrees to testify before Congress on Chinese espionage allegations, elevating Nvidia scandal to national security investigation level.

items.title: STAT+: Scientists debut map of basal ganglia, a key brain region involved in an array of diseases
items.snippet: A massive scientific collaboration has produced the most detailed map yet of the basal ganglia, a key brain region involved in an array of psychiatric and neurologic disorders.
items.line: Comprehensive basal ganglia mapping reveals potential pathways for treating psychiatric and neurologic disorders affecting millions globally.

items.title: American Cancer Society revises guidelines, urges routine PSA screening for prostate cancer
items.snippet: The American Cancer Society recommended routine PSA screening for prostate cancer, changing guidelines in place since 2010.
items.line: American Cancer Society reversal on PSA screening signals major shift in prostate cancer prevention strategy with implications for millions of men.

items.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
items.snippet: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump says only one man can take Jensen Huang's place as head of Nvidia: Tim Cook.
items.line: Trump nominates Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO role, creating unprecedented potential conflict with Apple leadership and signaling administration's tech industry influence.

items.title: Apple Notes adds a powerful new advantage in iOS 27.3
items.snippet:

items.line: iOS 27.3 expands Apple Notes capabilities with Siri AI controls, strengthening Apple's productivity suite against third-party alternatives.

items.title: Google’s new Android XR glasses work with iOS, Made for iPhone certified
